title: The Long Round
html:
Ellis's route runs through the northern woods and back along the southwestern track. He wants someone to walk it before he risks a loaded cart.

About

Given byEllis Pike
Level6
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points2

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Ellis Pike (outdoors near Binxonia) to get the quest.
  2. Ask the Stablemaster in Binxonia about the northern route.
  3. Check the clearing north of Binxonia.
  4. Kill 8 imps in the Binxonian Woodlands.
  5. Ask the Beggar west of the clearing about the road.
  6. Check the boar track south of Binxonia.
  7. Kill 6 boars there.
  8. Report the full route to Ellis Pike to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold140
Character XP4,000
Quest points2

What Ellis Pike says

Stablemaster: Start with the clearing north of town, where the black horse wanders. Check the route through there before Ellis takes a load along it.

Beggar: Not a cart past here today. The southern track's passable, if you keep the boars off it. I'd check there next.

Ellis Pike: Imps in the north, boars in the south. I'll take the round tomorrow while they're still keeping their distance. You've earned more than errand money today.

Handing it in
